register.labelZh: CREEP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: creep in 和 creep into something 可以描述疑慮、錯誤或不理想的變化慢慢出現,而人們起初未必察覺。；creep up 可以描述價格、溫度、數量和水平一點一點地上升。；creep over somebody 可以表示疲倦、恐懼、平靜或其他感覺逐漸影響某人或一群人。；creep up on somebody 可以描述考試、限期或特別日子在人尚未準備好時,便不知不覺地臨近。
register.summaryEn: Creep in and creep into something help you describe doubts, mistakes or unwanted changes that appear slowly and quietly. Creep up can describe prices, temperatures, numbers and levels that rise little by little. Creep over somebody can show how tiredness, fear, calm or another feeling gradually affects a person or group. Creep up on somebody can describe an exam, deadline or special day that becomes close before the person feels ready.
contextsZh: 描述事情為何突然顯得迫近
contextsEn: Describe changes that are difficult to notice
Describe feelings that slowly affect someone
Explain why an event feels surprisingly close

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；creep in 可以單獨使用;creep into something 則指出某種想法、感覺或錯誤慢慢出現在哪裏。；creep up 表示價格、數量或水平慢慢上升;creep up on somebody 則表示日期或事情在人沒有充分留意下慢慢臨近。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Creep in can be used by itself. Creep into something tells us where a thought, feeling or mistake slowly appears. Creep up means that a price, number or level slowly rises. Creep up on somebody means that a date or event gets close before the person fully notices.
